name: Gammu SMS Daemon
description: Send and receive SMS via the Gammu SMSD backend.
project_description:

 Gammu SMS module is a powerful tool designed to send SMS messages using Gammu SMS Daemon (smsd) once installed. This module provides a user-friendly interface, allowing users to easily connect with their customers and send SMS messages to a list of phone numbers.

 Features 
 
 User-Friendly Interface: The module offers a user-friendly web interface that makes it easy for users to compose SMS messages and send them to a list of phone numbers. This eliminates the need for complex command-line interactions with Gammu SMS Daemon. 
 Client Communication: Users can use the module to connect with their clients content type. Whether it's sending important updates, notifications, or promotional content, the module facilitates seamless communication. 
 Phone List: The module allows users to select their phone number lists.(Base on field telephone) 
 Message Composition: Users can compose SMS messages directly within the module's interface. 
 
 

 Getting Started 
 Follow these steps to get started with the Drupal Gammu SMS Module:

 Install Gammu SMS Daemon: Before using the module, ensure that Gammu SMS Daemon (smsd) is properly installed and configured on your server. This module relies on the functionality provided by Gammu for sending SMS messages.

 Configuration: Configure the module by providing the necessary information to connect it with your Gammu SMS Daemon database. This includes specifying the communication method, port, and any authentication details required.

 

 Phone List Setup: Import the phone numbers of your content type. This could be your client list, subscribers you want to communicate with. Example: create Node Content type client and field telephone number(you can add address field ) for name, last name you can map with name field or title

 

 Compose and Send: Start composing your SMS messages using the module's interface you can use with variable. Exemple : Dear {{name}}...

Once ready, select the recipients from your phone list and send the messages.

 

 Design on theme Bootstrap 5 admin
